name: Dropdown menu
looksLike: list of actions that opens below a button
small floating list with edit and copy choices
click more to reveal a vertical list of commands
definition: A menu of actions that opens next to a trigger button and closes after choosing an action or dismissing it.

notConfusedWith.difference: Holds general content rather than a keyboard-navigable list of menu commands.

prompts.short: Add a dropdown menu with keyboard navigation and Escape dismissal.
prompts.detailed: Add a button-triggered dropdown menu. Move focus into the menu on keyboard opening, support arrow-key navigation, and close on selection or Escape. Return focus to the trigger on dismissal, expose the expanded state, and use 44px targets.

reactTailwind: // Requires the Base UI variant of shadcn/ui dropdown-menu in the consuming project.
import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem } from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu";
<DropdownMenuTrigger className="min-h-11 min-w-11 px-4 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2">Document actions</DropdownMenuTrigger>
vue: <!-- A disclosure of links uses native Tab navigation, not ARIA menu semantics. -->
a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; }
nav { display: grid; border: 1px solid currentColor; padding: 8px; }

a11yNotes: Use a named trigger with expanded state
Manage menu focus and return it to the trigger on dismissal
